svg.aria-label: Nobody agrees on the problem yet, which is exactly where I like to start. I sit with the people who live with it until I can speak their language. Most problems have more than one right answer, and the fun part is knowing what each one costs. It’s only done when it runs in someone else’s hands, without me standing next to it.
